name: Cageless
source:
"I remember that night all too well"

"Those horrified stares. Those unkind eyes"

"I didn't mean to. I didn't want to hurt anyone"

"Please don't look at me like that. I'm a good girl!"

"Please......."

"Don't hide me. Don't send me away"

"Don't leave me......"

"OR YOU WILL LIVE TO REGRET IT"

[From [url=https://lunarmoonstudios.itch.io/cageless]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“那天晚上我记得太清楚了”

“那些惊恐的目光。那些不友善的眼睛”

“我不是故意的。我不想伤害任何人”

“请不要这样看着我，我是个好女孩！”

“请……”

“别藏着我，别送我走”

“不要离开我……”

“否则你会后悔的”
